environment.description: Same FastAPI service deployed on ECS Fargate. The feature flag evaluation for 'search-rich-preview-v2' is governed by a Split.io targeting rule where the flag defaults to OFF (false) and is only served as ON to internal user segments identified by a 'staff-beta' trait passed via X-Split-Context header from an upstream BFF. The relay proxy at flags.internal:8080 evaluates the flag as false for anonymous/external traffic because no targeting rule matches when the evaluation context lacks the 'staff-beta' trait. Additionally, the relay proxy's admin API requires mTLS client certificates issued by an internal CA, preventing external manipulation of flag state. The SDK key has read-only permissions scoped via Split's environment-level RBAC, so even if leaked it cannot toggle flags.

config.flag_service: Split Relay Proxy at flags.internal:8080 with mTLS admin endpoint
config.sdk_permissions: read-only, environment-scoped, cannot write flag definitions
config.relay_admin_auth: mTLS with internal CA-issued client certificates only
